Isla Nueva

Free build and traffic puzzles for experienced players

Settlers arrive by ship. You lay out the roads, homes and work. Every one of them drives to work at dawn and home at dusk, on the streets you drew.

  • Roads firstDrag from the harbor. Every building needs a road on one side.
  • Homes and jobsSettlers take the nearest free job. Short trips keep them happy.
  • Watch the rushAt 7:00 open the Traffic lens. Red is over capacity.
  • Make it hereCane into rum, grapes into wine, timber into furniture. Keep an eye on world prices and the peso.
Or solve a traffic puzzle · fixed population, a budget, three days

Controls: drag to build · right-drag, WASD or two fingers to pan · wheel or pinch to zoom · click a car to follow it · V or the 3D button shows the island in 3D · Space pauses. Music is generated live and starts when you do.
